product_mix.quote: Roughly we have around 55% of order which is having a high voltage class. 55% to 60% is a high voltage class, 400 kV and above.

guidance.statement: Endeavor to achieve high single-digit to early double-digit full-year advertising revenue growth

margin.statement: Q2 FY27 gross margin at 59.9%, H1 at 60.8%; EBITDA margin 25%, PAT margin 21% despite raw material volatility

pricing_cost.statement: Planning a 5% consumer price increase in Q3 FY27 split between 2-3% frontal price hike and similar ml-age reduction

product_mix.statement: Growth portfolio brands relaunched with refined propositions in amla oils, body lotion, and Banjara's extensions; profitability substantially improved

In Banjara's, we have introduced packs that extend the brand into large adjacent categories, which could offer significant growth potential for us if we are successful.

risk.quote: Going forward, the cost environment remains volatile, and we stand committed to taking actions as appropriate to protect our P&L while being fair to our consumers.

guidance.quote: Guidance, we will maintain 30% to 35% CAGR from the AUM perspective, and 35%-40% CAGR from profitability perspective.

guidance.quote: We believe that the current supply chain mandates we have from our anchor clients, we can achieve this AUM growth in next 2 to 3 years, which will translate into 30%-35% AUM growth Y-o-Y.

margin.statement: Maintain ROA >4.5%, cost-to-income <15%, yield ~13% (11-15% range)
margin.quote: We have also achieved all our key operating parameters: maintained nil NPA, return on assets is more than 4.5% and cost-to-income continues to remain less than 15% and we plan to maintain this in quarters to come as well.

capex.statement: Invested INR48 crore for 15% stake in tech subsidiary to build in-house AI digital stack

fund_raise.quote: No. Our mid-term target was to not leverage ourselves beyond debt-to-equity of 3x. other.statement: GIFT City subsidiary for overseas supply chain; operational in ~1 year; dual RBI/IFSCA approval
other.quote: For that reason, we are setting up our wholly owned subsidiary in GIFT City. But it has a dual approval requirement from RBI and IFSCA, so it's a long gestation. This is going to take maybe a year or so to be operational there.

other.statement: RBI draft revolving credit guidelines aligned with current term-based model; only minor doc/system tweaks needed
other.quote: RBI guidelines currently are in draft form. We are not allowing extension, or rollover of any of our facilities.

guidance.statement: Focus remains on delivering sustainable VNB growth, balancing growth, profitability, risk and prudence; protection and annuity stay central.
guidance.quote: Our strategy remains unchanged, delivering sustainable VNB growth while balancing business growth, profitability, and risk and prudence. Protection and annuity stay central to our strategy, addressing significant underpenetrated needs in India.

demand.statement: Retail protection growth expected to taper in H2 from 40-50% levels to more moderate levels.
demand.quote: The expectation is that as you get into H2 of this year, those growth numbers should taper down from the 40%-50% that we've been seeing to more moderate levels.

demand.statement: Annuity and guaranteed products attractive in IRRs and have done well across all distribution channels.
demand.quote: These products are very attractive in terms of IRRs, both the annuities, which have been on the regular pay variety, as well as the guaranteed products, which also are both income as well as lump sum variety. And they've done quite well across all of our distribution channels.

margin.statement: VNB margin expansion from FY2026 to H1 FY2027 largely explained by product mix shift.

pricing_cost.statement: Company repriced non-par products as a continuous exercise based on market yields.
pricing_cost.quote: So we have repriced. This is a continuous exercise for us. We look at what are the yields that are available in market, and then we offer that to customers. It is a continuous process, Shreya.

pricing_cost.statement: Improved profitability from yields and opex is passed on to customers via better pricing to propel demand.
pricing_cost.quote: The idea is to be able to pass on to the customer, because clearly you should be able to create demand. If your product is a rupee cheaper than the next competitor, then it clearly helps propel that demand.

product_mix.statement: Par to non-par mix in last quarter broadly in the range of 60:40.
product_mix.quote: So this year, for instance, has started to move towards non-par, and specifically in the last quarter, the mix is broadly in the range of 60:40, par to non-par.

product_mix.quote: If the rates stay high for longer, then it is likely that non-par as a share, and this also adds annuity to it, both of these can become a larger proportion of the business, not just for us, for others as well.

risk.statement: Consultation paper on distribution economics is early; regulator collecting feedback, no closure yet.

risk.statement: Too early to call volume impact from proposed commission structure changes; renewal commission space provides comfort.

other.statement: Operating expenses excluding GST and stamp duty reduced at 8% CAGR over last three years.

other.statement: Agency channel to continue receiving investment; gross agent additions grew 23% in half-year.
other.quote: I think the opex advantage that we have allows us to continue to invest in Agency. And even when you look at this half-year, in terms of the gross addition of agents, that's 23% growth, which is ahead of the rest of the market.

guidance.statement: Full-year FY27 ESOP non-cash expense expected around INR79-80 crores.
guidance.quote: Yes. So the noncash expense for ESOP cost for the full year FY '27 would be around INR79 crores, INR80 crores.

product_mix.statement: SIF product launches expected over next couple of quarters.

other.statement: Costs split into inflation-linked routine expenses and upfront investments in people, technology, distribution.

other.statement: Alternative investment team has over 20 professionals, expanding investor servicing, operations, sales, distribution.

guidance.statement: Targets doubling profits over 3.5 years, no need to raise capital, aiming for 20% ROE.

guidance.statement: Expects ₹3,000-3,500 crores fund redemption over next 6-18 months, hopes most money returns.
guidance.quote: I think, yes, that fund will go back over the space of next 6 - 18 months. So, that’s the only large fund, I think, which is up for redemption, which is around about ₹3,000 - 3,500 crores.

guidance.statement: Expects to be full-fledged capital markets platform by March 31, with big pickup in Q1 next financial year.
guidance.quote: I think from a full stack perspective we’ll be really ready on 31st March, first week of April, in terms of the entire team and talent being there. Needless to say, early green shoots in terms of us winning the right set of mandates has always been on the cards.

guidance.statement: Expects asset management flows to meet targets for current year.
guidance.quote: I think flows will kind of come back and overall should be in a position to meet our targets for the current year.

margin.statement: Expects 100-150 bps cost-to-income improvement year-on-year.
margin.quote: I think we had guided for a 1 - 1.5% kind of overall improvement year-on-year. I think we are well on course to achieve that.

margin.statement: Aims to move cost-to-income from 48 towards 46-47 over 12-18 months.
margin.quote: I think we'll continue our journey and keep it going over the next 12 - 18 months. Doesn't necessarily mean our standalone employee cost numbers will reduce, but we will continue to try and make the firm as productive as possible.

guidance.statement: Stand-alone operating margin guidance of around 45% on an annual basis, subsuming all expenses including IPL
guidance.quote: So this margin guidance of about 45% for the broking and distribution business on an annual basis, subsumes all the expenses, including the IPL.

guidance.statement: Consolidated operating margin guidance of 40% to 45% in the near term
guidance.quote: On a consol basis, so the guidance is anywhere between 40% to 45% in the near term.

demand.quote: In September, average daily orders rebounded to 5.8 million, up nearly 12% from August.

pricing_cost.quote: I think for the time being, we are not looking at any increase in the lending cost. So it remains at 14.99%.

product_mix.quote: Our wealth business is gaining depth as well with Ionic Wealth AUM at ₹ 160 billion, up 19.1% over Q1 FY27.

risk.statement: New business burn (drag on EBITDA margin) at 3.5% to 4%, up from 2.5%-3% six quarters ago
risk.quote: So that burn is about 3.5% to 4%, as I mentioned in the previous call also. So it remains in that range.

other.statement: Brand spend as percentage of revenue expected to decline over time as revenue scales while spend stays flat
other.quote: You should expect that over a period of time as a percentage of revenue, definitely, the spends will come down unless we sort of see a new opportunity.

other.statement: Client cash margins converted to G-Secs causing net cash position decline from INR 2,700 crores to INR 900 crores

guidance.statement: Expects to achieve upper end of EBITDA guidance for FY27.
guidance.quote: I think considering the first two quarters of half -yearly projection that we have of INR1,100 crores, we can definitely achieve the upper part of the guidance.

demand.statement: Domestic module demand could grow ~64% YoY this year based on installation trajectory.
demand.quote: Based on the current installation trajectory, domestic module demand is running a pace that could translate into approximately 64% year-on-year growth for this year.

demand.statement: Open-access inquiries consistently increased, with deliveries and execution up.
demand.quote: Yes, absolutely. We have seen the open -access inquiries consistently go up. Of course, in the last 3 months, there has been, the inquiries there has been no changes at all, especially because people have geared up to do DCR in their open access, and so which is pretty much a compulsory.

margin.statement: Expects to maintain margins as per previous indication.
margin.quote: See, if you see, all our order book is in the same line, so I do not see anything is going to be on a negative on the margin sides. And as of our orders are in hand, we have the margins what we have indicated is going to be continued.

margin.statement: Non-DCR margins broadly stable due to product differentiation.
margin.quote: That's a good question, sir. If you look at the margins for non-DCR, for the company, it has been broadly going same as what it used to be, this thing.

order_book.statement: Order book as of Sep 30, 2026 was ~10.4 GW, with 1.5 GW inflows in Q2.
order_book.quote: Coming to our order book, as of 30th September 2026, our order book stood at approximately 10.4 gigawatts, supported by new order inflows of approximately 1.5 gigawatts during the quarter.

order_book.statement: About 5-5.5 GW of order book to be delivered in next 12-15 months.
order_book.quote: Out of the 10.4 gigawatts order book, we should have about 5 gigawatts that is delivered, 5 gigawatts to 5.5 GW that is delivered in the next 12 to 15 months.

capex.statement: 6 GW integrated TOPCon cell and module project on track; module commissioning by December, cell by March 2027.
capex.quote: The module line, as our Chairman mentioned in the speech, that it will be ready by December 2026, whereas cell line by March '27.

capex.statement: Total capex for 6 GW cell and module is INR5,500 crores, with hard cost INR4,600 crores.
capex.quote: So, Apoorva ji, that INR5,500 crores are for both cell and module of 6 gigawatt each. And it includes, where the hard cost is around INR 4,600 crores and the remaining cost is for your interest during construction, contingency, margin money for working capital for soft costs, which we have also detailed out in the presentation as well as in the prospectus.

capex.statement: Plans for 9 GW ingot and wafer facility in two phases, timing guided by ALMM-III and market conditions.
capex.quote: Our current plan envisages a 9 g igawatt of facility developed in two phases of 5 g igawatt and 4 gigawatt, aligned with our future cell manufacturing requirements. The timing of this investment will be guided by the regulatory development, particularly ALMM List -III, prevailing market condition, and long-term economic viability.

pricing_cost.statement: Pricing is function of raw material costs, efficiency; cost increases passed to customers.
pricing_cost.quote: Pricing is generally a function of raw -material costs, module or cell efficiency, and operational efficiency. For example, when silver prices increased, we reduced silver consumption, which offset the cost increase.

product_mix.statement: Module sales split: 25% retail/KUSUM, 75% institutional (C&I and utility).

product_mix.statement: More than 50% of capacity converted to G12R; remaining after M10R orders.
product_mix.quote: So, right now we have converted more than 50% of our capacity to G12R. The remaining, we have some order orders in hand for to complete the M10R, after which we will convert everything.

risk.statement: ALMM-II implementation after December 2026 looks extremely unlikely.
risk.quote: So, we got your question. So, what I was saying is that ALMM-II implementation after 2026 deferment looks extremely unlikely, especially that there is significant amount of time that is given for the industry to realign.

other.statement: Received 25% capital subsidy from State Government for earlier project; similar expected for upcoming projects.
other.quote: We have also declared that we have received capital subsidy for our earlier project from the State Government to the tune of 25%, and the s ame, similar subsidies are there, expected in the upcoming projects as well.

guidance.statement: Medium to long term EBITDA margin target is 70% plus.
guidance.quote: See, overall, we are looking at this as a 70% plus EBITDA margin business. That's what we feel for the medium term and the long term.

demand.statement: Next lot of B200 expected to go live this quarter.
demand.quote: So the next lot of B200 which we have already announced is expected to go live this quarter, hopefully soon.

order_book.statement: Signed nearly INR1,000 crores deal with a Sovereign AI company for Blackwell cluster through June 2029.
order_book.quote: So we signed a nearly INR1,000 crores deal with a Sovereign AI company for the Blackwell cluster, which lasts through June 2029.

capex.statement: Deployment of 1,024 B200 GPUs expected this quarter.
capex.quote: This quarter, we expect the deployment to go through for the 1,024.

pricing_cost.statement: For uncontracted or short-term contracted capacity, earnings expected to grow from same assets.
pricing_cost.quote: But as we go forward, for our uncontracted capacity or short-term contracted capacity, we obviously expect the earnings to grow from the same assets that we have.

product_mix.statement: Majority of GPUs run on own platforms, very little bare metal sold.
product_mix.quote: Majority of our GPUs today run on top of our platforms. There is very, very little bare metal that we sell today.

fund_raise.statement: No mental limit on debt; comfortable as long as front-end cash flow supports repayment.
fund_raise.quote: We are very comfortable with debt as long as we have the ability to repay. So, we don't have an upper limit defined for ourselves that, okay, we can't go beyond this on debt or anything like that.

risk.statement: Order-to-deployment cycle for GPUs can vary between 3 to 6 months.
risk.quote: So we find that this order-to-deployment cycle can vary between 3 to 6 months, typically.

other.statement: No specific target for contracted revenue percentage.
other.quote: There is no specific target in our mind. I think it is more of a tactical question which needs to be answered in multiple steps, which keeps changing.

other.statement: No decision made on next lot of B200 usage or contracts.
other.quote: No, we have not decided anything around the next lot of B200.

guidance.statement: Expect H2 to be better than H1.
guidance.quote: And we expect, as we have said last time also, we expect H2 to be better than H1.

guidance.statement: Expect FY27 pipe volumes higher than FY26.
guidance.quote: So, overall, volume s in FY'27 should be higher than FY'26 volumes.

demand.statement: Domestic water business softness continues, impacting capacity utilization.
demand.quote: This pressure was further compounded by lower capacity utilization due to lower execution in water pipe business as softness in domestic water business continues.

margin.statement: Expect margins to move towards double-digit from Q3, Q4 onward.
margin.quote: So, we can expect Q3, Q4 onward that the margins will be moved towards, you know, double-digit and we are expecting and we expect that very soon this situation will be same what we were doing few quarters back.

margin.statement: Expect margin improvement in H2 vs H1 due to better oil and gas volumes.
margin.quote: However, in the coming quarters, Q3 and Q4, we are expecting some improved volumes in oil and gas sector, which will definitely lead some better margin or margin improvement as compared to H1.

order_book.statement: Additional LOI USD50 million for export to South East Asia; total order book vicinity INR17,000 crores.
order_book.quote: So, if we add this 50 million further, so this will be the our total order bo ok would be in the vicinity of INR17,000 crores.

capex.statement: Seamless pipe plant in Abu Dhabi: 300,000 tons per annum, investment ~USD330 million, commercial operations FY28-29.
capex.quote: The project, with a proposed capacity of 300,000 tons per annum and an estimated investment of approximately USD330 million, is intended to strengthen the company's presence in Middle East oil and gas market.

capex.statement: Saudi JV to set up helical and longitudinal pipe facilities, 300,000 metric ton each.
capex.quote: The joint venture envisages setting up two advanced pipe manufacturing facilities, helical pipes and longitudinal pipes with a capacity of 300,000 metric ton each, catering to the region's growing water infrastructure and energy requirement.

pricing_cost.statement: Surging raw material costs, particularly coking coal, squeezed DI pipe margins.
pricing_cost.quote: Surging raw material costs, particularly for coking coal have squeezed margins in the DI pipe business.

product_mix.statement: New orders from oil and gas and exports to change product mix and improve margins.
product_mix.quote: And we are seeing that from Q3 onwards, we may see some upward trend in terms of margins also because this new orders will change the product mix in the time to come. Because the majority of the orders are coming from the oil and gas sector and exports.

risk.statement: Geopolitical tensions in West Asia causing shipping delays and revenue recognition delays.
risk.quote: Ongoing geopolitical tension in West Asia have worsened due to recent escalation s in Saudi Arabia, a region where we hold significant export order exposure. The main challenge is not other order cancellation, but rather delay in shipping and revenue recognition.

risk.statement: Abu Dhabi DI plant facing cost overrun, underutilization, and delivery constraints.
risk.quote: The Abu Dhabi DI plant is facing a combination of cost overrun, underutilization, and delivery constraints, including difficulties serving customers who cannot be reached through truck-based transportation.

other.statement: Anti-dumping duty on Indian DI pipe exports to Saudi Arabia not impacting company as it exports via Abu Dhabi.
other.quote: However, the other manufacturers in India, the duty is being imposed on them in the range of 16 % to 25% to 30%, based on the -- their export to this region and their pricing. So, that is something which is positive for us that we are not included in the anti-dumping duty liability.

other.statement: Saudi DI pipe project put on hold; will serve market from Abu Dhabi.
other.quote: Right now, considering the Saudi scenario, we have put on hold that venture. It in any case was very small.

guidance.statement: Expects mid-double-digit consolidated revenue growth for H2 FY27, around 15%.
guidance.quote: So in terms of the guidance, we just say that we are looking for mid -double-digit revenue growth, and this can be somewhere around 15% in that range.

demand.statement: Expects momentum to pick up after Diwali, especially till March.
demand.quote: But what it looks like is that after Diwali, the expected momentum would catch up for th e near future, okay, especially till March.

demand.statement: Sees strong demand from cement, power, steel, fertilizers, and ports for MHE.
demand.quote: Execution improved progressively compared with Q1, while demand from steel, power, cement, fertilizers and ports remains supportive.

margin.statement: Expects to maintain minimum EBITDA margin at last year's level.
margin.quote: Given continued macroeconomic uncertainty and inflationary environment, but improved execution cycle, we are expecting a medium double-digit consolidated revenue growth for remaining part of the year while maintaining minimum EBITDA margin at last year's level.

margin.statement: Guides 20-22% EBIT margin for Gear division.
margin.quote: So we could -- we used to always guide to our shareholders that we will maintain 20% to 22% EBIT margin for gear, and we are happy to re port that we are leading towards that trajectory that we always wanted to achieve.

order_book.statement: Gear open order book INR1,056 crores as of Sep 30, 2026, up 37% YoY.

order_book.statement: MHE open order book INR579 crores as of Sep 30, up 27.3% YoY.
order_book.quote: The open order book reached to INR 579 crores as of September 30, up 27.3% year -on-year. This provides sound execution visibility.

order_book.statement: MHE secured orders worth approximately USD9 million in H1 FY27.
order_book.quote: Our MHE division is now establishing a meaningful international presence, securing orders worth approximately USD9 million during the first half.

capex.statement: Capital expenditure program for 3 years remains on track.
capex.quote: We also remain committed to our capital expenditure program for 3 years, which remains on track.

pricing_cost.statement: Took price hikes and improved product mix to offset input costs.
pricing_cost.quote: So we have basically, we have taken a price hike and also a bit of improvement of product mix.

product_mix.statement: Product mix: 53% catalog, 47% engineered.
product_mix.quote: It's about 53% is catalog, 47% is engineering.

fund_raise.statement: Board declared interim dividend of INR0.50 per share.

risk.statement: Notes volatility in steel prices and inflationary pressures.

guidance.statement: Bank sticks to 15-16% loan and deposit growth guidance, preferring higher end, around 16%.
guidance.quote: So in terms of guidance, bank has already given a guidance of 15% to 16% in terms of loans and deposits. I think we would like to stick on to that. But preferably, it will be in the higher bucket of that guidance, what we have given.

guidance.statement: ROA expected to inch up from 1.1% to 1.20-1.25% within a year.
guidance.quote: I am pretty sure that this is likely to inch up from the 1.1, which we are currently at to 1.20 and 1.25 levels very shortly, maybe in a year itself, we should see that k ind of a movement.

guidance.statement: Medium-term ROA target is 1.25% to 1.30%, long-term target 1.5%.
guidance.quote: And of course, our medium -term target will be to reach 1.2 5% to 1.30%. And obviously, our final -- as a long-term target will be to reach that 1.5% mark.

margin.statement: NIM should improve and move towards 3.36 to 3.38 levels in the shorter term.
margin.quote: And we believe that this Repo rate what has hiked and the consistent churning what we are doing, the NIM should improve and move towards 3.36 to 3.38 levels in the shorter term.

margin.statement: NIM expected to improve to 3.36-3.38% in shorter term and 3.45-3.50% over 12 months.
margin.quote: And of course, in the longer term, our 12 months or 4 quarters guidance will be around 3.45 to 3.50, we should take. So that is what the guidance for NIM.

pricing_cost.statement: Corporate loan yields increased 25-30 bps due to Repo and T-Bill rate upticks.
pricing_cost.quote: So both the aspects, if you see for the last 3 months, there has been upticks in -- up to the extent of maybe 25 to 30 basis points. So to that extent, the new corporate bookings have started increasing.

pricing_cost.statement: Repo rate hike passed on to new gold loans, but no spread increase yet.
pricing_cost.quote: And in terms of gold loan, at this point of time, the Repo price what is there that has been passed on to the new loans, but we have not thought of increasing the spread at this point of time.

product_mix.statement: Retail segment outperforming wholesale; growth in MSME, retail, agri disbursements.
product_mix.quote: The retail segment is currently outperforming the wholesale segment. I can tell you that, that there is a significant amount of push happening and there's growth happening in retail side.

product_mix.statement: Gold loan share targeted to increase from 25% to 30-32% immediately, eventually 35%.
product_mix.quote: So bank already is targeting to take it up to 35%. So that I will stand by that as a first phase, then let us see how the industry evolves. And then from there, we will take on. B ut at this point of time, the focus will be to take it up to 30%, 32% levels immediately.

fund_raise.statement: Board permitted raising INR500 crores of Tier 2 bonds; no major capital raise expected now.
fund_raise.quote: Currently, the Board has permitted us to raise INR500 crores of Tier 2 bonds. And we are currently not expecting a raising of capital at this point of time when we are well capitalized at 19.40.

risk.statement: ECL provisioning impact not substantial due to low SMA and net NPA.
risk.quote: It's not very substantial. That much I can say. It is not very substantial because you can see from my balance sheet itself because the SMA numbers are at the lowest, the net NPA numbers are at the lowest.

other.statement: Cost-to-income ratio expected to come down to 50% going forward.
other.quote: I think we are right on that because we should see the cost-to-income ratio coming down to 50%, 50% going forward.

other.statement: Opex growth will be lower than loan growth.
other.quote: It will be -- opex growth will be lower than the loan growth. There will be opex growth, but it will be lower than loan growth.

guidance.statement: No change in guidance; on track to meet or exceed 25% AUM growth, similar profit growth, and 20% ROE.
guidance.quote: So there's no change in guidance as such. But I think, hopefully, we are on track to meet and exceed the guidance. So the guidance there is like 25% AUM growth and similar profit growth and ROE of around -- the upper end of the guidance and ROE is 20%.

guidance.quote: So in the medium to long term, we got to keep it above 20%, that's what our target is.

guidance.statement: Home finance AUM growth guidance of 18% to 20%, well within that; ROE target 16% to 18% for next year.
guidance.quote: We had guided growth of 18% to 20% on AUM, we'll be well within that because we are already at 8% after two quarters.

demand.statement: Microfinance growth to pick up in second half with festival season momentum.
demand.quote: And now I think the second half of the year, you can see a little more momentum building up during the festival season and there, we can see the momentum building up.

margin.statement: Home loan boarding yield increased to 11.81% in Q2, expected to pull up portfolio yield over 2-3 quarters.
margin.quote: If you see for quarter 2, the yield has gone up to 11.81%, which is much above the portfolio rate. So with every passing quarter, this will pull up the yield.

margin.statement: MSME yields lower due to shift to superior quality borrowers; new business yield around 12.5% to 13.5%.

guidance.quote: It will be in similar range. Average of last two quarters should be looked at for forward guidance as well.

guidance.statement: KuberX loan disbursement target of INR 25,000 crores in next 4 to 6 quarters

guidance.statement: Target Housing.com profitability within 12 to 18 months
guidance.quote: We are targeting to make Housing.com profitable within 12 to 18 months; I repeat, within 12 to 18 months.

guidance.statement: Revenue per team member to increase quarter-on-quarter for next 10 to 12 quarters
guidance.quote: We believe revenue per team member will continue to go up quarter-on-quarter for next 10 to 12 quarters.

product_mix.quote: I can't give you a definite guidance, but I can tell you so much that it will be amongst the last 8 or 9 quarters, it will be the best quarter compared to the last 8 or 9 quarters.

risk.statement: Stage II and III increases are technical, not credit concerns.
risk.quote: As far as the gold piece is concerned, this Stage II is technical in nature. You are aware, most of the gold loan product is a 3 -month or 2.5 -month behavioural tenor product. So this will not translate into a credit cost.

other.statement: Insurance income contribution to ROA is about 0.1%.
other.quote: So, from an ROA tree perspective, I would put the number at about 0.1% in the ROA tree from an income perspective, a little over 0.1%.

other.statement: Branch profitability at INR6-7 crores AUM in 12-13 months.
other.quote: Typically, a branch, if it reaches about INR6 crores to INR7 crores of AUM, it turns profitable for us. when the price is going on an upward trajectory or even the price that is there today, in 12 to 13 months, the branch starts touching that number.

guidance.statement: Expects Q3 and Q4 volumes stronger than Q2; H2 typically 20% higher than H1.
guidance.quote: Based on our current indication, we expect Q3 and Q4 volumes to be stronger than Q2. Overall volumes and historically also H2 is always 20% up on H1.

guidance.statement: Exports expected to be 45% higher this year than previous year.
guidance.quote: Year-on-year, we expect this year to be 45% higher than our previous year.

margin.statement: Backward integration into seamless tubes expected to add 3-4% margin on overall business.
margin.quote: on the overall business, we should be having a margin of approximately 3% to 4% once we use our own seamless tubes for it.

margin.statement: Seamless tube cost expected 8-10% lower than existing buying prices.
margin.quote: it should be at around approximately 8% to 10% lesser than -- or you could say more competitive than existing buying prices.

capex.statement: Plans INR60 crores immediate capex via warrants and pref shares over next two quarters.
capex.quote: close to INR60 crores we are planning on an immediate capex via warrants and pref shares, which we would be spending between the next 2 quarters.

capex.statement: Seamless tube facility production trials planned for February or March 2027.
capex.quote: The sizing mill and straightening mills have been received and installed, and we plan to undertake production trials in February or March of 2027.

pricing_cost.statement: Price revisions with OEMs and Tier 1 customers to support Q3 and Q4.
pricing_cost.quote: the price revisions, including -- concluded with the OEMs and Tier 1 customers are expected to support us during the Q3 and Q4.

pricing_cost.statement: Steel prices increasing each quarter; OEMs and mills discussing another increase in Q3.
pricing_cost.quote: steel as a commodity, we see increase going on in each and every quarter. I do believe that OEMs and mills are also talking about another increase in quarter 3 as well.

fund_raise.statement: Preferential issue of INR63.6 crores to fund expansion initiatives.
fund_raise.quote: The company is completely focused on capacity expansion and gearing up for the coming years, which is also witnessed by a preferential issue to the tune of INR63.6 crores.

guidance.statement: H2 FY27 EBITDA growth expected in mid-to-high teens, with FY27 better than initial guidance.
guidance.quote: So we expect a very strong closing for the year and we definitely stay true on the guidance, that yes, H1 has been far stronger than the guidance and we expect the trends to continue but definitely mid-to-high teens (EBITDA) for the balance of the year is something that we are anchored towards.

guidance.statement: Q3 FY27 RevPAR growth expected in double digits.
guidance.quote: We see a lot of pick up happening around the long festive weekends that are there in the months of October and November. So we are very much on track for double -digit growth in terms of RevPAR in Q3 as well.

guidance.statement: Effective tax rate anticipated to be in the 20s in FY27.
guidance.quote: We anticipate an effective tax rate to be in 20s in FY27.

demand.statement: International business grew low double-digit last quarter, expecting return to 50-50 mix.
demand.quote: International business has also started slowly trickling in. In the last quarter, there was a low double-digit growth in terms of international business (even excluding BRICS).

margin.statement: Excluding ESOP and Coorg, flow-through was around 60% for the quarter.
margin.quote: Excluding the ESOP cost, the EBITDA margin will be even better. The flow-through, excluding ESOP and exclud ing Coorg because Coorg is also stabilizing and it's not giving the EBITDA numbers as Jaipur and Udaipur, flow-through would be around 60% for the quarter.

margin.statement: Management fees flow down to 85% to 90% into EBITDA for new managed openings.
margin.quote: So, yes, for a new managed opening, if you get a management fees, it flows down to 85% to 90% into the EBITDA.

order_book.statement: Contracted to over 5,200 keys by FY30, with about 2,600 under ownership.
order_book.quote: Our goal currently, we are already contracted, and at various, including our openings that we are at various stages of development, at over 5,200 keys by FY30, and which will include 2,600 or so keys, which will be under our ownership.

capex.statement: Planned capex spending: around INR 450 crores by end of this year, INR 600 crores next year.
capex.quote: By the end of this year, we will be spending around INR450 crores. Next year, we are looking at spending around INR600 crores, and subsequent to that, the balance capex.

capex.statement: Capex for five contracted pipeline hotels is around INR 1,432 crores, with INR 150 crores spent.
capex.quote: So, I'll tell you the capex for our five contracted pipelines, is Agra, Srinagar, Ayodhya, Ranthambore, Bandhavgarh is around INR1,432 crores. We have spent around INR150 crores.

capex.statement: Mumbai BKC project capex remains INR 800 crores, split equally between equity and debt.
capex.quote: There is no change in the overall capex cost as of now. The INR 800 crores of our committed capex remains the same; INR 400 crores of equity and INR 400 crores of debt.

pricing_cost.statement: Corporate rate negotiations targeting mid-to-high double-digit growth for CY27.
pricing_cost.quote: So we are pitching for mid -to-high double-digit growth rates in terms of our ask rates , but the negotiations are on.

product_mix.statement: Suite occupancy rose over 700 basis points, with paid suite occupancy in mid-40s.
product_mix.quote: If you look at our portfolio, our suite occupancy has risen by over 700 basis points. That shows you how our guests are willing to pay for experience and quality.

fund_raise.statement: Seeking shareholder approval for incremental fund infusion to buy FSI for BKC project.
fund_raise.quote: Since this is a material transaction with a related party, with the JV entity, Leela will shortly reach out to the shareholders for an approval of investment.

risk.statement: Dubai asset operating at breakeven EBITDA, with renovation planned for early FY28.
risk.quote: We are looking at taking the hotel under renovation in early '27, I would say probably early FY28, to be precise, like April or so is when we to start the renovating hotel, and finish the renovation within a year.

other.statement: Borrowing costs reduced by 30 basis points from mid-October through lender renegotiation.
other.quote: Additionally, our borrowing costs have reduced by a further 30 basis points from mid -October, as we have actively renegotiated with our lenders, which provides a shield from potential transmission of policy rate hikes.

guidance.statement: Raw material basket expected to increase 4-5% in Q3 FY27
guidance.quote: And our guidance going ahead for Q3 would be a further increase of about 4% to 5%.

demand.statement: Demand steady in Q3; Q4 expected to be strong due to OEM year-end closing
demand.quote: We see the demand being steady in Q3. And Q4, as we know, that will be the year-end closing for most of the OEMs also, there will be good demand coming in.

margin.statement: Expect some margin improvement in Q3 despite raw material cost pressures
margin.quote: So I see that some basic points going forward in Q3, definitely, there would be some improvement in terms of the margins.

order_book.statement: JK Tornel expects normal sales comparable to last year by Q4 FY27
order_book.quote: we are hoping that we will come back to the normal sales, which would be comparable to last year's sales.

capex.statement: New expansion of Rs 1,130 crore underway; further phased capex of ~Rs 5,000 crore planned
capex.quote: we are now taking up expansions immediately for INR1,130 crores, which is going on and then thereafter in phases for around INR5,000 crores capex.

capex.statement: Balance capex for FY27 around Rs 500 crore after Rs 800 crore spent in H1
capex.quote: This is going to be roughly around INR500 crores for the balance period.

pricing_cost.statement: NSR increased 7% QoQ in Q2; planning further 4-5% increase in Q3
pricing_cost.quote: And going ahead in Q3, we are planning a further increase in our NSR of 4% to 5%.

product_mix.statement: Premium SKUs (16 inch & above) account for nearly 30% of passenger line volumes in H1 FY27
product_mix.quote: At JK Tyre, nearly 30% of passenger line volumes sold in H1 are towards premium SKUs i.e. 16 inch & above tyres.

risk.statement: West Asia conflict driving raw material inflation; cumulative 30% increase in last 6 months
risk.quote: Cumulatively, we have seen a staggering 30% increase in the last 6 months.

other.statement: EV volumes surged 24% QoQ; leadership in electric truck & bus segment
other.quote: we are proud to share that our EV volumes have surged by 24% over the previous quarter.

other.statement: Domestic volumes grew 22% YoY in Q2; OE up 25%, replacement up 20%
other.quote: Domestic markets recorded a healthy volumes growth of 22%, driven by a robust 25% in OE Market and a similar 20% in replacement markets.

guidance.statement: Targeting INR 1 lakh crores annual sales; aiming for 11 million ton production in FY27 with 6 million tons in H2
guidance.quote: Our aim is to reach to about 11-million-ton production in this financial year as targeted earlier. We have reached to a level of about 4.79 million tons in H1. And the next, that is H2, we are aiming for 6 million tons.

guidance.statement: Confident of achieving 3 million tons per quarter in H2; production planning at 960,000 tons per month
guidance.quote: So, we are quite confident that we'll be in a position to achieve these 3 million tons per quarter. So that means 1 million ton per month. To be very precise, the production planning is 0.96 million tons, that is, 960,000 tons per month.

demand.statement: Domestic steel demand growing ~10% YoY; exports ~100,000 tons/month; optimistic on Q3/Q4 with festival season and construction pickup
demand.quote: The steel scenario is very good. I think it is now around 10% Y-o-Y basis, there's a growth. Though our production has gone up by 20%. The industry overall growth is about 10%.

margin.statement: Adjusted EBITDA INR 2,504 crores, up 34% YoY; EBITDA per ton INR 10,529, up 5% YoY; sequential moderation due to higher raw material and operating costs
margin.quote: Our adjusted EBITDA stood at INR 2,504 crores, up 34% Y-o-Y, while adjusted EBITDA per ton increased 5% Y-o-Y to INR 10,529 per ton. The sequential moderation in EBITDA was primarily due to higher raw material and operating costs.

capex.statement: Annual growth capex guidance of INR 7,500-10,000 crores; H1 FY27 spend INR 3,187 crores; INR 8,000-9,000 crores remaining on INR 47,000 crores plan
capex.quote: Our stated framework envisages annual growth capex of approximately INR 7,500 crores to INR 10,000 crores, primarily funded through internal accruals, while seeking to maintain net debt to EBITDA below 1.5x through the cycle.

pricing_cost.statement: Coal gasification saving INR 70 per kg vs propane; switched reheating furnaces, galvanizing and color-coating lines to syngas permanently
pricing_cost.quote: You see the propane prices have gone up to a level of about INR 100 per kilo. And equivalent when we make coal gas, that is called syngas, then equivalent, we were getting in INR 30 a kilo. So that advantage was INR 70 a kilo.

product_mix.statement: Targeting 65% flat products (including plates) and 35% long products mix
product_mix.quote: We are now aiming to increase our overall product mix towards flat products. Though today also, we are at a level of about 60% -40%. Now we'll be reaching somewhere about 65%-35%, 65% flat products, including plates and 35% will be long products.

other.statement: Net debt-to-EBITDA improved to 1.51x from 1.71x; net debt INR 14,786 crores; cash INR 7,237 crores
other.quote: Our consolidated net debt declined by INR 1,141 crores from INR 15,927 crores at the end of June to INR 14,786 crores as at September end. Net debt-to-EBITDA ratio improved from 1.71x to 1.51x.

other.statement: New pellet plant (4th) commissioning by June 2025; current 3 plants producing 33,000 tpd all consumed internally
other.quote: As far as the new pellet plant is concerned, yes, it is on the way. On the way means it has come up. Hopefully, by June next year, this will be fully commissioned.

demand.statement: Plans about 80 to 90 lakh smart meters this year, balance 40-45 lakh in next half year.
demand.quote: So we plan for about 80 to 90 lakh meters this year. And the balance about 40 lakh, 45 lakh, we hope that we will be able to complete in the next half year.

demand.statement: Merchant volumes expected around 3,500 million units per quarter on overall basis.
demand.quote: You are right. But again, we have to be mindful of the fact that renewable, both wind and solar will be a seasonal profile. But on an overall basis, it would be of the order of 3,500 million units per quarter.

margin.statement: Long-term PPA margins expected in the order of INR0.80 to INR1 on a consistent basis.
margin.quote: So we will tie up on a long -term basis where those margins will be in the order of INR0.80 to INR1 on a consistent basis.

order_book.statement: About 60% of smart metering order book delivered; balance to complete in 12 to 14 months.
order_book.quote: Smart Metering, we have now delivered about 14.8 million meters so far. And around 60 percentage of our order book, that we have delivered and balance portion, we wish to complete in another 12 to 14-month time.

order_book.statement: Transmission order book remains at about INR87,000 crores after adding two projects.
order_book.quote: As far as Transmission is concerned, during this quarter, we added another two projects. One is at Vizag Pendurthi and second one is Satara. And with these two projects, our order book remains at about INR87,000 crores.

capex.statement: Locked in capex of more than INR100,000 crores to be delivered in 4 to 5 years.
capex.quote: And we have already locked in capex of more than INR100,000 crores and that we will be delivering in another 4 to 5 years. So asset will grow almost 1.3x, 1.4x from what we have today in next 5 years.

capex.statement: Deployed about INR7,850 crores of capex in first half across all businesses.
capex.quote: In fact, since we have been focusing continuously on capex delivery on the ground, and we see now results coming up, the capex in this first half of the year in the all-time high. We have deployed about INR7,850 crores of capex in among all our businesses.

capex.statement: Expects total transmission capex of about INR14,000 crore, with INR8,000-9,000 crores in second half.
capex.quote: We expect to do total capex of transmission in the range of about INR14,000 crore. So we will be doing about INR8,000 crores to INR9,000 crores of capex in second half.

product_mix.statement: AEML 750 MW PPA approved by regulator, execution expected over next 3 to 4 weeks.
product_mix.quote: As far as 750 megawatts is concerned, that's already approved by the regulator. All process already done. We are in the process of executing that, expect that to happen over the course of next 3 to 4 weeks.

product_mix.statement: Plans to scale aggregate capacity on both sides to 7,000-8,000 megawatts over 3 to 4 years.
product_mix.quote: So in terms of volume, we will certainly continue to scale up this. And currently, we have about 2,500 megawatts of MSEDCL PPA. We will be doing another PPA with AEML, where regulatory approval has already been achieved, so we will be doing that PPA.

fund_raise.statement: Intellismart transaction expected to close in next one month after CCI approval.
fund_raise.quote: And we expect the CCI approval very soon. And once we have the CCI approval, we will complete the transaction immediately. So we expect that will happen in next one month time.

risk.statement: Debt largely fixed rate or hedged; 75-80% of debt portfolio on fixed coupon basis.
risk.quote: No, no, no. All our USD bonds modes and ECBS, the interest rates are fixed. So 75% to 80% of our debt portfolio is on fixed coupon basis.

risk.statement: Generator bears curtailment risk; responsibility starts once power is scheduled.
risk.quote: So essentially, how it is being done is that in any PPAs that you would have, whether it is with AESL or whether it is with any utility, generator is to schedule that power, and once it is scheduled, that becomes your responsibility to uptake and pay for that.

guidance.statement: NIM expected to recover to approximately 5.8% by Q4 FY27 as excess liquidity is deployed and repo rate increases materialize
guidance.quote: Just in terms of how do we see NIMs going forward, we see this recovering to approximately 5.8% by Q4 as some of these excess liquidity would have been definitely put to use by them and also the expected repo rate increase, which we also are factoring for the course of the year.

guidance.statement: Bank aims to operate at 55% incremental cost-to-income ratio for FY27, implying operating jaws of ~500 bps
guidance.quote: So we feel overall this year, i.e., in '27, we can operate the bank at 55% cost -income ratio. So that explains to you why I requested you to plug that 55% into the stack.

guidance.statement: Loan growth visibility of at least 20% and deposit growth capacity of 20-22% on core basis (ex-FCNR)
guidance.quote: So 20 -20 both sides. So you know that the income will keep flowing in strongly. Now for a 20% growth, if our opex growth is 15%, then you know 500 basis points.

demand.statement: Corporate banking book growing >30% YoY; A+ rated corporates 76%, BBB 20%, BB and below 4%; near-zero delinquency over 7 years
demand.quote: A and above rated companies, since you said what kind of customers we lend to in the corporate side, A and above rated companies, we makes 76% of our book. And BBB companies is 76%. BBB companies is 20% and BB and below is 4%. That is a composition. It's quite comfortable actually and with zero default practically. And just imagine 7 years, Piran, no delinquency.

margin.statement: FCNR impact on ROA estimated at minimal 2 bps as lower NIM is offset by reduced opex and credit costs on expanded asset base
margin.quote: The one point which I want to sort of also put across is that the margin impact on FCNR should not be viewed in isolation as because FCNR comes in the denominator, it correspondingly also reduces operating expenses and credit costs related to assets. And hence, we have estimated that the overall impact on the ROA could be very minimal as low as 2 basis points.

order_book.statement: FCNR(B) mobilization of INR34,390 crores (USD3.6 bn) in Q2 FY27, constituting 10% of total deposits; FCNR-backed loans of INR25,000 crores (7% of loan book)
order_book.quote: During the quarter, the bank mobilized INR34,390 crores, which is about USD3.6 billion of FCNR (B) deposit under this scheme. This constituted about 10% of the overall deposit that we have at September 30, 2026.

capex.statement: No explicit capex guidance; opex grew 16% YoY and 3.7% QoQ to INR5,942 crores in Q2 FY27
capex.quote: Moving on, the opex for the quarter was at INR5,942 crores. This grew by 16% on a Y-o-Y basis and by 3 .7% on a sequential basis.

pricing_cost.statement: FCNR deposits provide ~1% cost of funds benefit vs domestic deposits (6.85% vs ~7.8% all-in), including 40-50 bps IBU spread, no PSL requirement, and hedging costs
pricing_cost.quote: Our own estimate of that cost of funds money is basically it's about 6.8% or so or 6.85%. Similarly, when we have to go -- had this money had to be raised in India at this point of time and you know the rate currently, our own sense will cost us, including the CRR/SLR cost, maybe the annualized cost would be, if a customer rate is 7.25%, you add some annualization to 7.45% to 7.50%, and then you a

product_mix.statement: Credit cards in force crossed 5 million; outstanding book INR9,875 crores; spends grew 15% YoY; zero forex markup feature launched
product_mix.quote: With respect to credit cards, happy to report that the cards in force crossed 5 million during the quarter. The book on an outstanding basis stood at INR9,875 crores, and the credit card spends grew at a healthy pace of about 15% on a Y -o-Y basis.

fund_raise.statement: Debut offshore bond issuance of USD950 million from IBU branch; investment-grade ratings from S&P and CareEdge obtained
fund_raise.quote: On the back of the ratings, we also did a debut bond issuance. We almost raised close to $1 billion of bonds. The actual number was US$ 950 million, and these were raised from the offshore IBU branch from marquee international investors.

risk.statement: El Niño and drought in Maharashtra, Karnataka being monitored; no immediate asset quality impact seen for Q3/Q4 but cautious outlook
risk.quote: We are, of course, very watchful of this El Niño and the impact will cost to us that a couple of states have declared drought, etcetera. We have to see how much portfolio we have to manage that. But as I can see right now, it doesn't look like there's an immediate impact in Q3 or Q4, and then we'll take it as it comes.

risk.statement: IRDAI insurance commission consultation paper may reduce fee income; impact expected to be offset by FCNR benefit (~1%), repo rate hikes (50-75 bps), and product mix changes
risk.quote: We have estimated the impact as is in the current form that if this has to come, this will definitely reduce our fee income. But we feel that, to a large extent, the impact can be offset by the expected repo increase and the FCNR benefit, which I have talked earlier. We will also continue to work on product mix changes and closely monitor the developments in this regard.

other.statement: Core PAT crossed INR1,000 crores in Q2 FY27 (INR1,036 crores); ROA 0.93%; CET1 13.01%, CAR 14.66%; LCR 125% avg (139% Sep)
other.quote: This quarter on the core, without any adjustments, it is INR1,036 crores. So we feel good about that. I always said that we'll be in kissing distance of 1% ROA. It looks like we will get there. In fact, this quarter also, we had ROA of about 0.93%.

guidance.statement: Management is not in a position to give any guidance for the next 2 years due to market and geopolitical uncertainty
guidance.quote: We are basically not in a position to give any guidance for the next 2 years. We will see how the situation pans out, and then it will depend on the market performance, based on that we'll see.

guidance.statement: Current profitability run rate will continue; revenue depends on market conditions and a better festive season than last year
guidance.quote: So current profitability, we will continue. Revenue will again depends on how the market pans out. We are hoping to -- for a better festive than last year, but it again depends on how things move from here.

demand.statement: Festive season has begun and management is hopeful momentum continues over the next two quarters
demand.quote: Yes. We also hope because typically, the festive has begun and the next 2 quarters, we are hoping -- hopeful that the momentum continues.

demand.statement: Advertising environment requires a measured and client-focused approach; focus on leveraging regional presence and integrated capabilities
demand.quote: The advertising environment continues to require a measured and client-focused approach. We remain focused on leveraging Radio City's strong regional presence, established advertiser relationships, and integrated media capabilities to capture available opportunities.

margin.statement: Q2 FY27 operating profit before tax was INR1.5 crores versus an operating loss of INR13.3 crores in Q2 FY26
margin.quote: Operating profit before tax stood at INR1.5 crores compared with an operating loss of INR13.3 crores in Q2 FY26.

margin.statement: H1 FY27 operating profit before tax was INR5.6 crores versus an operating loss of INR20.2 crores in H1 FY26
margin.quote: Operating profit before tax stood at INR5.6 crores compared with an operating loss of INR20.2 crores in H1 FY26.

margin.statement: Reported profit before tax for Q2 FY27 was INR8.9 crores compared to a loss of INR6.4 crores in Q2 FY26
margin.quote: Reported profit before tax stood at INR8.9 crores compared to a loss of INR6.4 crores in quarter 2 FY26.

capex.statement: Quarterly cost base has stabilized around INR39-40 crores for the last three quarters and should continue
capex.quote: So, if you see from last 3 quarters, basically, the cost is around this INR39 crores, INR40 crores for the quarter, and that should continue.

product_mix.statement: Non-FCT contribution is currently 18% to 20% of revenues; focus is on shoring that up profitably
product_mix.quote: So currently, 18% to 20% of our revenues come from non -FCT contribution. So, we are looking at shoring that up and therefore, the effort is to actually do as many as is are -- so long as they are profitable.

product_mix.statement: Priorities include strengthening core radio monetization, increasing engagement with strategic advertisers, expanding non-FCT revenues, and building traction in branded content, events, sponsorships and digital integrations
product_mix.quote: Our priorities include strengthening core radio monetization, increasing engagement with strategic advertisers, expanding non -FCT revenues, and building further traction in branded content, events, sponsorships and digital integrations.

risk.statement: Management cannot comment on dividend plans at this time
risk.quote: Right now, we cannot comment on that.

guidance.statement: Expects to comfortably cross AUM growth guidance for this year.
guidance.quote: With strong collections, controlled slippages and credit cost, we are well poised to continue our strong traction in disbursements in coming quarters, which will help us cross our growth guidance for this year very comfortably.

guidance.statement: Expects flattish credit slippages and credit cost for rest of year.
guidance.quote: We expect flattish credit slippages and credit cost for the rest of the year, despite the industry headwinds. Let me repeat, we expect flattish credit slippages and credit cost for the rest of the year, despite the industry headwinds.

demand.statement: October disbursements expected around Rs. 550 crores, picking up in November-December.
demand.quote: So, we expect the disbursements to be somewhere around Rs. 550 crores for this month and then pick up in November and December to get to a good growth number over the previous quarter.

margin.statement: Expects 10-12 bps margin moderation for the half year.
margin.quote: But if you look at the half year, yes, about 10-12 bps.

margin.statement: Expects margin compression, not expansion, due to repo rate increases.
margin.quote: No, margin expansion is not possible , Nischint, because we are already seeing the effect of the repo rate increase on our existing borrowings, which are both external benchmark linked and MCLR linked.

pricing_cost.statement: Expects to exit FY27 with cost of funds around 8.90%.
pricing_cost.quote: We should possibly be ending the year with more around an 8.90% kind of a number.

pricing_cost.statement: Increased yields on incremental disbursements by 1% effective October 2026.
pricing_cost.quote: However, we expect to cushion this impact through yield increases on our incremental disbursements, which has been made effective from October 2026.

product_mix.statement: Targets mix of 25% sub-3 lakh, 50% 3-5 lakh, 25% above 5 lakh.
product_mix.quote: Roughly, we are at about 26%-27% of sub 3 lakhs and another about 51%-52% on the 3-5 lakhs and the rest being in the greater than 5 lakhs. But it will move to a largely 25-50- 25.

risk.statement: Slippages expected around 70 bps for next couple of quarters.
risk.quote: But for the next couple of quarters, given that there is a sizable stock in the 61 to 90 day bucket, you will possibly see the slippages at around the 70 basis point levels.

risk.statement: GNPA ratios expected to remain sticky for next couple of quarters.
risk.quote: So, you will see that number being a little sticky for the next couple of quarters.

other.statement: Opex ratio expected to trend down by 50-75 bps over next couple of years.
other.quote: Our sense is that this number will trend down at least by 50-75 basis points over the next couple of years.

other.statement: Expects to cross Rs. 100 crores in NPA resolutions for full year.
other.quote: So, the current trend gives us the confidence that for the full year, the resolution from NPA will cross Rs. 100 crores.

guidance.statement: EBITDA margin guidance maintained at 25.5-26.5% for FY27
guidance.quote: So, as far as the margin guidance is concerned, so we would like to maintain the same guidance , 25.5 to 26.5 %.

guidance.statement: R&D spend guidance 2.8-3% of revenue for FY27, expect upper end near 3% including ACTx impact
guidance.quote: And as far as the R&D guidance , so guidance was given 2.8% to 3% of the revenue. For this fiscal , we expect the R&D spend to be at the upper end of the guidance , which will be close to 3% of the revenue with accounting fo r the impact of ACTx in the R&D.

guidance.statement: International business expected to grow double digits in FY27
guidance.quote: So, we expect double growth in international business in the Financial Year ’27.

guidance.statement: Export growth guidance 20% on constant currency dollar basis for FY27
